copy.curiosityHook: When the modern public mistakes him for a provocative performer, how far can a resurrected dictator rise before anyone notices?
copy.description: After waking up in present-day Berlin at the site of his former bunker, Adolf Hitler finds himself mistaken for an eccentric comedian and catapulted into sudden media fame.
copy.vibeSummary: A biting, medium-paced German comedy balancing sharp laughs with provocative, thoughtful bite.
copy.whyWatch: Director David Wnendt mines sharp comic friction from a high-concept premise that uses viral celebrity culture to explore an unthinkable modern return.

allowedMaterial: Hitler reawakening in modern Berlin at former bunker site
Rapid rise as a media phenomenon
excludedMaterial: Later media stunts or plot climaxes
